questions.question:
밑줄 친 부분 중, 쓰임이 다른 것 하나는?

Today is the school club day. Club members are ①doing fun activities now. Let's meet them!

Do you like robots? I'm Yeji from the robot club, We Makers. My club members learn ②programming and build robots. Right now, we are ③testing our robots. We are ④helping each other. Watch out! There is Jake's robot ⑤running away!
questions.explanation: ①③④⑤는 현재 진행형(be + -ing)의 형태로 '지금 진행 중인 동작'을 나타낸다. ②는 명사로 '프로그래밍하다'는 의미이며, 'learn programming'에서 동명사로 사용되었다. 따라서 쓰임이 다른 것은 ②이다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓖ 중, 어법상 틀린 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

Today ⓐis the school club day. Club members ⓑare doing fun activities now. Let's meet ⓒit!

Do you ⓓlike robots? I'm Yeji from the robot club, We Makers. My club members learn programming and ⓔbuild robots. Right now, we are testing our robots. This is Jake's spider ⓕrobots. Watch out! His robot is ⓖruning away!
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'them'이 맞다. 'Let's meet them'은 '그들을 만나자'는 의미. ⓕ 'spider robot'이므로 복수형 'robots'가 아닌 단수형이어야 한다. ⓖ 'running'의 철자가 틀렸다. 따라서 어법상 틀린 것은 ⓒ, ⓕ, ⓖ이다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

ⓐ I use a painting app for my pictures.
ⓑ With this app, I can use many kinds of brushes and colors.
ⓒ My club members will post our new webtoons on our social media site this Friday.
ⓓ Why don't you visit our social media site and reading our webtoons?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 문법적으로 올바르다. ⓑ 문법적으로 올바르다. ⓒ 문법적으로 올바르다. ⓓ는 'and' 뒤에 병렬 구조를 이루어야 하므로 'reading'이 아닌 'read'가 되어야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B) 에 공통으로 들어갈 단어를 고르시오.

We will make a music video (A)___ Melodia, a singing club in Singapore.
(B)___ this app, I can use many kinds of brushes and colors
questions.explanation: (A)에 들어갈 단어: 'make a video with ~' = '~와 함께 비디오를 만들다'. (B)에 들어갈 단어: 'With this app' = '이 앱으로'. 둘 다 'with'가 들어간다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓖ중, 어법상 틀린 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

ⓐWelcome to my club, New Voice. I'm Hayun. My club members sing songs and ⓑperform together. My club ⓒwill practice for a global music project now. We ⓓwill make a music video with Melodia, ⓔa singing club in Singapore. Melodia and New Voice are ⓕnot in the same countries, but we ⓖcan create one beautiful sounds.
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'will practice'는 시간부사 'now'와 함께 사용할 수 없다. 'is practicing'이 맞다. ⓕ 'in the same country'이어야 한다 (단수형). ⓖ 'one beautiful sound'이어야 한다 (sound는 단수형).

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 올바른 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

ⓐ I can use many kinds of brushes and colors.
ⓑ I'll introduce my school garden to you.
ⓒ Club members will do fun activities now.
ⓓ My club members sing songs and performing together.
questions.explanation: ⓐ 올바르다. ⓑ 올바르다. ⓒ 'will do'와 'now'는 함께 사용할 수 없다 ('are doing' 사용). ⓓ 'sing'과 'performing'이 병렬 구조를 이루지 않는다 ('performing' 대신 'perform' 필요).

questions.question:
밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 잘못된 것은?

Today is the school festival day. There are fun shows and activities. Look! The school band ①is performing. My friend Hojun is playing the drums now. After the show, I am visiting the cooking club. Eunbi is selling her cookies there.
questions.explanation: 'After the show'는 미래 시간을 나타내므로, 현재 진행형 'am visiting'을 사용할 수 없다. 'will visit'이 맞다. 나머지는 모두 올바르다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 올바른 것을 고르시오.

A Yujin, I'm going ①joining the school singing contest next month.
B Wow! Tom, are you good at ②sing a song?
A Yes, I'm good at them.
B Good luck in the contest!
A Wait, you are a good singer, too. Why do you ③join the contest with me?
B Sounds great! ④We'll make a great team.
questions.explanation: ① 'I'm going to join' (going + join은 중복). ② 'are you good at singing' (전치사 뒤에는 동명사). ③ 'Why don't you join' (미래 제안 표현). ④ 올바르다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

① Welcome __ my club, New Voice. I'm Hayun.
② I'll introduce my school garden __ you.
③ I send an email __ my teacher.
④ The guide shows the map __ the tourists.
⑤ My club is practicing __ a global music project
questions.explanation: ① to (Welcome to), ② to (introduce to), ③ to (send to), ④ to (show to)... 아니, 모두 'to'가 들어간다. 문제를 다시 검토하면: ① to ② to ③ to ④ to ⑤ for 이므로, ⑤가 다르다.

questions.question:
다음 중, 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것을 고르시오.

① We will make a music video with Melodia, a singing club __ Singapore.
② Melodia and New Voice are not __ the same country.
③ New Voice is preparing __ a global music project.
④ This is my favorite place __ the school.
⑤ We meet __ the science room every Thursday.
questions.explanation: ① in (in Singapore) ② in (in the same country) ③ for (preparing for) ④ in (in the school) ⑤ in (in the science room). ③만 'for'가 들어가고 나머지는 'in'이다.

options: New Voice and Melodia will sing the same song in their own countries.
New Voice and Melodia will compete against each other in a music contest.
New Voice will travel to Singapore to perform with Melodia.
Only New Voice will perform in the music video, while Melodia watches.
Although New Voice and Melodia are in different countries, they can come together as one through music.
questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

Welcome to my club, New Voice. I'm Hayun. My club members sing songs and perform together. My club is practicing for a global music project now. We will make a music video with Melodia, a singing club in Singapore. Melodia and New Voice are not in the same country, but we can create one beautiful sound.
questions.explanation: 텍스트에서 '다른 나라에 있지만 하나의 아름다운 소리를 만들 수 있다'는 것은 음악을 통해 거리를 극복하고 하나가 될 수 있다는 의미이다.

questions.question:
다음은 Brian과 Hayun이가 나눈 대화이다. 윗글의 내용을 토대로 다음 중 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.

Brian: Hi, Hayun. What club are you in?
Hayun: Hi, Brian. I'm in the New Voice club. What about you?
Brian: Wow, that's cool! I'm in Dream and Draw. What does New Voice do?
Hayun: We sing songs and perform together. ① This time, we're practicing for a global project with a singing club from another country. What do you do?
Brian: We create webtoons. ② We use a drawing app to make them. ③ There are few colors in this app, but we have different brushes.
Hayun: Wow, that's really interesting! I hope to see your webtoons.
Brian: ④ Our new webtoons will be posted this Friday. ⑤ Visit our social media site and check them out!
Hayun: Thanks! I hope you'll watch our performance sometime too!
questions.explanation: 원문에서 'My club is practicing for a global music project now'이라고 했는데, 대화에서는 'This time, we're practicing for a global project'라고 했다. 원문의 'with Melodia, a singing club in Singapore'라는 구체적인 정보가 빠져있으므로 덜 정확하다.

questions.question:
윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ～ⓔ중 가리키는 바가 적절하지 않은 것은?

Brian's club is Dream and Draw, and his club members make webtoons. They use a painting app for my pictures. With ⓐthis, they can use many kinds of brushes and colors. ⓑThey will post our new webtoons on our social media site this Friday. Why don't you visit our social media site and read ⓒthem?

Hayun's club is New Voice. Her club members sing songs and perform together. They are practicing for a global music project now. ⓓThey will make a music video with Melodia, a singing club in Singapore. Melodia and New Voice are not in the same country, but ⓔthey can create one beautiful sound.
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'They'는 'New Voice'의 멤버들을 지칭하므로 'New Voice' 자체가 아니라 'New Voice의 멤버들'을 나타낸다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 <보기>에서 답할 수 있는 것끼리 묶인 것을 고르시오.

Do you like robots? I'm Yeji from the robot club, We Makers. My club members learn programming and build robots. Right now, we are testing our robots. This is Jake's spider robot. Watch out! His robot is running away!

Hi! I'm Brian. This is Dream and Draw, and my club members make webtoons. Mina is writing a story, and I am drawing pictures. I use a painting app for my pictures. With this app, I can use many kinds of brushes and colors. My club members will post our new webtoons on our social media site this Friday. Why don't you visit our social media site and read our webtoons?

<보기>
ⓐ What app does Brian use to draw?
ⓑ How many webtoons has Brian's club made?
ⓒ Where do Yeji's club members test their robots?
ⓓ When will Brian's club members post their new webtoons?
ⓔ Where will Brian's club members post their webtoons?
ⓕ What do We Makers members and Dream and Draw members do?
questions.explanation: ⓐ 답변 가능: painting app. ⓑ 답변 불가능: 몇 개인지 명시되지 않음. ⓒ 답변 불가능: 어디서 테스트하는지 나와있지 않음. ⓓ 답변 가능: this Friday. ⓔ 답변 가능: social media site. ⓕ 답변 가능: We Makers는 로봇 학습/제작, Dream and Draw는 웹툰 제작.

questions.question:
[지문]
Do you like robots? I'm Yeji from the robot club, We Makers. My club members learn programming and build robots. Right now, we are testing our robots. This is Jake's spider robot. Watch out! His robot is running away!

Hi! I'm Brian. This is Dream and Draw, and my club members make webtoons. Mina is writing a story, and I am drawing pictures. I use a painting app for my pictures. With this app, I can use many kinds of brushes and colors. My club members will post our new webtoons on our social media site this Friday. Why don't you visit our social media site and read our webtoons?

Welcome to my club, New Voice. I'm Hayun. My club members sing songs and perform together. My club is practicing for a global music project now. We will make a music video with Melodia, a singing club in Singapore. Melodia and New Voice are not in the same country, but we can create one beautiful sound.

다음 표는 동아리들의 활동과 특징을 정리한 것이다. 아래 글을 표의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation:
표의 빈칸을 채우기 위해 각 동아리 소개 글을 분석하면:

① 'testing' - "Right now, we are testing our robots"에서 적절
② 'move' - "His robot is running away!"에서 로봇이 움직임을 알 수 있음
③ 'uploads' - "will post our new webtoons"이므로 'post'가 맞으며 'uploads'는 부자연스러움
④ 'play' - "sing songs and perform together"에서 공연하다는 의미로 적절
⑤ 'same' - "not in the same country"에서 적절

따라서 ③ 'uploads'가 가장 적절하지 않은 답이다. 'post'를 사용해야 한다.
